scope: Two static side-view environment concept illustrations for arrival on a planet and underground mining.
method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; one generation per distinct composition.
methodReason: Large painted scene and style exploration. These are not exact tile masks or runtime terrain.
nativeDimensions: Read actual generated PNG dimensions after generation; preserve original bytes without resizing.
referenceRole: Approved hand-drawn art style, terrain treatment, depth hierarchy, palette and cyan hero design; composition may change.
seams: Not tileable; no claim of shared-edge accuracy or WFC compatibility.
shapeAccuracy: Readable natural supported terrain and walk surfaces. No collision or reachability certification.

outputs.intent: Surface arrival and a visible path descending into the underground entrance.
Deep cave mining with partly exposed embedded ore, two explorers and restrained ecological variety.

animationBoundary: Water, plants, light and mining debris are static motion design references here. A production version must separate them for animation and effects.
implementationBoundary: No Game, YYGC, gameplay, ship reactivation, Unity import or runtime changes.
